title: Spearmint Mint E-Liquid 60ml (3000mg)
description:
Add a fresh twist to your CBD routine with SupremeCBD’s Spearmint Menthol CBD E-liquid. Perfect for those always on the go, our CBD E-liquid is easy to use, making sure you get your CBD whenever you need it. Just fill up your vape, and you’re ready to enjoy the cool, refreshing flavour, no matter where your day takes you.
Our blend is crafted with a precise 80% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 20% VG (Vegetable Glycerin) ratio, ensuring every vape is smooth and satisfying. Try our fresh Spearmint Menthol CBD E liquid today!
Our Spearmint Menthol CBD E-liquid is the perfect way to blend the calming benefits of CBD with the crisp, clean taste of spearmint and the cooling rush of menthol. Simply pop it in your vape in your bag or pocket, ensuring you never miss out on your CBD.
